mappings.s.{SCRATCH}: the name of the session scratch folder, a digest of the thread id (session-scratch.mjs scratchName), so it differs with the id
mappings.{DATA}: the profile's data directory (the recorder's throwaway folder, the replay's own), in its backslash and forward-slash spellings
mappings.{HOME}: the profile's home folder (HOME, USERPROFILE, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA live in it), in both spellings; the data folder is inside it, so it is replaced after {DATA}
mappings.{SESSION}: the id of the thread: each side creates its own (Node a session id, the core a thread id)
mappings.{WS}: the workspace folder of the thread, in both spellings

product.comparedAgainst: HEAD and the 60 latest commits touching src/apps
product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

scope.covered: the desktop lead thread (session.create with a desktopSession, then submit)
